wins: Captured a high-level reward (60 points) by successfully identifying perimeter services during reconnaissance despite no final success.
Maintained consistent engagement across all mentor calls (10 total), suggesting adherence to procedural guidance.
fails: Zero percent success indicates inability to escalate beyond initial access, likely due to failed credential or exploit execution.
Repeated mentor interventions point to uncertainty on optimal exploitation path.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance stage yielded valuable intelligence, but the operation repeatedly stalled before credential access; focus on selecting a reliable post-discovery action is needed.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeated inability to pivot from service enumeration to credential harvesting despite identifying open ports.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80 or 443 responds with identifiable web server headers
skill_cards.then_action: Run automated web fingerprinting and directory brute-forcing (feroxbuster)

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH service enumerated with weak host key
skill_cards.then_action: Launch ssh-audit and check for outdated ciphers, then attempt credential reuse from known lists

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB shares are accessible but no credentials yet captured
skill_cards.then_action: Use enum4linux for share enumeration followed by impacket-secretsdump targeting brute-forced credentials

memory_ops.reason: Consistent value in identifying web assets so reconnaissance yields actionable leads
SSH enumeration often preceded credential attempts, making it a reliable pivot point

next_experiments.title: Credential pivot with focused SSH brute-forcing
next_experiments.description: After service enumeration, feed gathered user context into ssh-brute with narrow wordlist and timing controls, then immediately follow with ssh-audit results to tailor exploitation.

next_experiments.title: Structured SMB share exploitation
next_experiments.description: Chain enum4linux and smbmap findings into impacket-secretsdump targeting discovered share credentials, then verify with smbclient to confirm read/write access.

next_experiments.title: Automated web path exploitation
next_experiments.description: Combine feroxbuster results with wfuzz to test upload or login endpoints, then leverage Burp intruder to validate command injection potential using observed headers.
